Finite exhaustive proof with full standalone verifier; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The radius-one centered box in the first higher-rank integral symplectic group is a canonical minimum arithmetic counting instance; the complete trace coefficient profile refines the main scalar count by a conjugacy invariant and supplies a reproducible benchmark for trace-stratified higher-rank lattice counts. This is a motivated exact natural invariant, not arbitrary parameter slicing, and the frame completion distribution adds structure. No speculative larger-radius theorem claimed.
